description: Phase 5 arm B tuning base: B2 HMM trained by minibatch SGD with momentum 0.5 on softmax logits (same epochs and minibatch as the BE model) on spect pooled with 20% of the training pool held out as validation (split seed 0, test set unchanged) and the best-validation checkpoint. Tuned values are passed by the tuning sweep (--lr, --pseudo-count, --smoothing, --order); the values here are the paper defaults used as tie-breakers.
